name: Willow tree
style: low-poly, flat colours, drooping crown of faceted foliage (Quaternius 2019)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: The plan's source (a Quaternius static willow on poly.pizza) is behind a Cloudflare challenge; this is Willow_4 from Quaternius's Ultimate Nature Pack on OpenGameArt (License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0), the same zip as the tree, tree-pine, tree-palm, tree-autumn and bush entries, so they read as one set. Of the five green willows in the pack it reads best as a weeping willow: a broad dome (6.5 x 9 m) that falls in curtains to about 2 m on every side, over a leaning trunk that forks into the crown and shows through the gaps between the curtains; Willow_1 and Willow_2 hang similar curtains but their crowns sit lopsided off a trunk that shows only at one edge, Willow_3 is a closed mushroom dome with short drapes, and Willow_5 is two separate domes on a bent trunk. The foliage is closed shells (a doubleSided render was identical), so it is not double-sided. Height 10 m: a mature weeping willow on a river bank or pond edge is 8-12 m, its curtains sweeping down to head height over a 1.6 m person. Colours on noon (no green), as the other trees: foliage vermilion (accent) shading to iris, so the willow sits with them as the same foliage; the trunk is pale moon-cream shading to iris, distinct from the near-black broadleaf trunk, the vermilion pine trunk and the skin-tan palm trunk, and light enough to stand out against the iris shade of the curtains it shows through. Static: no clips.
